answer: Each challenge is derived from task data and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, whose unpredictable, publicly verifiable output is unavailable for precomputation. Participants commit to the round before the pulse, then reveal responses bound to its value. A knoll of automated identities cannot farm answers offline; a gale of retries gains no advantage, while the trellis of deadlines and verifiable commitments makes coordinated abuse costly.
